amiibo Complete Guide: Daily Free Rewards and Fabric Collection
手办每天扫一次，奖励白给；但先刷谁、布料怎么换、没有手办亏不亏，这三件事值得先搞清楚。

Scan a figure once a day and the rewards are free — but which figures to scan first, how to swap fabrics, and whether you're missing out without any figures: those three questions are worth sorting out first.

哈里的取舍：没有手办也不亏
Harry's Take: No Figures, No Loss
图：游戏实机截图（林克撑着魔王布料滑翔伞滑翔，右下为加农多夫 amiibo 手办，图片来源：Zelda Wiki）。
Image: Actual in-game screenshot (Link gliding with the Demon King fabric paraglider; a Ganondorf amiibo figure at bottom right. Source: Zelda Wiki).
这篇写给两类玩家：一是手头有塞尔达系列手办、却不知道在王国之泪里能刷出什么的玩家；二是正纠结要不要为这游戏买手办的玩家。先说结论：手办是锦上添花，不是通关必需品——布料纯属外观，装备大多能在游戏里找到别的获取途径，这一点后面会展开。前置条件只有一个：离开初始空岛、来到地面之后，能力轮里会出现 amiibo 能力；还在初始空岛教学阶段时，这个能力尚未解锁，扫了也没用。

This guide is for two kinds of players: those who own Zelda-series figures but don't know what they can get from them in Tears of the Kingdom, and those wondering whether to buy figures for this game. The bottom line first: figures are a nice bonus, not a requirement for beating the game — fabrics are purely cosmetic, and most equipment can be found elsewhere in the game, as explained later. The only prerequisite: after leaving the Great Sky Island and reaching the surface, the amiibo ability appears on your ability wheel; while you're still in the Great Sky Island tutorial, the ability isn't unlocked yet, so scanning does nothing.
选能力。
Pick the ability.
按住 L 打开能力轮，选中 amiibo 图标。能力轮里没有这个图标，说明进度还没到地面，先推进主线。
Hold L to open the ability wheel and select the amiibo icon. If the icon isn't on the wheel, your progress hasn't reached the surface yet — advance the main quest first.
贴手办。
Tap the figure.
把手办贴到手柄的 NFC 感应点：Joy-Con 是右侧摇杆顶部，Pro 手柄是手柄中央的 Nintendo Switch 标志处；Switch Lite 同样是右侧摇杆。贴稳后按 L，地面上会出现落点标记。

Tap the figure on the controller's NFC point: the top of the right stick on a Joy-Con, the Nintendo Switch logo in the center of a Pro Controller, and the right stick on a Switch Lite as well. After tapping it in place, press L and a drop marker will appear on the ground.
对准落点再按 L。
Aim the drop point, then press L again.
把落点标记移到一块平坦空地上，再按一次 L，奖励会从天上掉下来。箱子、材料与武器都可能出现，开箱前先确认周围没有敌人和悬崖。

Move the drop marker to a flat, open spot, then press L again and the rewards will fall from the sky. Chests, materials, and weapons may all appear — before opening chests, make sure there are no enemies or cliffs nearby.
奖励的构成有规律：塞尔达系列手办会掉同类材料加一个宝箱，宝箱里可能是专属武器、专属防具或专属滑翔伞布料；非塞尔达系列的手办只能掉通用材料与武器，不会出专属奖励。想刷专属奖励，认准塞尔达系列手办，别指望其他游戏的手办出限定装备。

Rewards follow a pattern: Zelda-series figures drop matching materials plus a chest, which may hold an exclusive weapon, exclusive armor, or an exclusive paraglider fabric; non-Zelda figures only drop generic materials and weapons, never exclusive rewards. For exclusive rewards, stick to Zelda-series figures — don't expect limited gear from other games' figures.
规则一：每只手办每天只能扫一次。
Rule 1: Each figure can only be scanned once per day.
同一只手办当天扫第二次不会再掉奖励，想继续刷同一只，只能等第二天。手办之间互不影响：你有十只手办，一天就能扫十次。

Scanning the same figure a second time on the same day drops no more rewards; to keep farming the same figure, you'll have to wait until the next day. Figures don't affect each other: with ten figures, you can scan ten times in one day.
规则二：专属奖励靠随机掉落，但布料最先来。
Rule 2: Exclusive rewards drop randomly, but fabrics come first.
多数专属滑翔伞布料在第一次扫描对应手办时就会掉落，之后重复扫描同一只手办，掉的多是同类材料与武器。也就是说，布料收藏的进度取决于你有多少只不同的塞尔达手办，而不是同一只刷多少遍。

Most exclusive paraglider fabrics drop the first time you scan the matching figure; scanning the same figure again afterward mostly yields matching materials and weapons. In other words, fabric-collection progress depends on how many different Zelda figures you own, not how many times you scan the same one.
规则三：奖励从天而降，落点要自己选。
Rule 3: Rewards fall from the sky, and you pick the drop point yourself.
游戏不会帮你挑安全位置，落点选在水边、悬崖边或敌人堆里，奖励可能滚落、沉水或被敌人抢先一步。扫描前先站到平坦空地上，这个习惯能省下很多捡东西的麻烦。

The game won't pick a safe spot for you — drop points near water, cliffs, or enemy packs can send rewards rolling away, sinking, or getting grabbed by enemies first. Stand on flat, open ground before scanning; this habit saves a lot of chasing after loot.
手办多的时候别乱扫，按下面三档排顺序，先拿对游戏体验影响最大的：
When you have many figures, don't scan at random — follow the three tiers below and grab the most game-changing rewards first:

Tier
手办
Figure
值得刷的理由
Why It's Worth Scanning
第一档：先刷
Tier 1: Scan First
大乱斗林克、暮光公主林克
Smash Bros. Link, Twilight Princess Link
有机会刷出神马伊波娜——系列经典坐骑，拿到后去驿站登记，别让它在野外走丢；同时出黄昏勇者套装与暮光之镜布料。
A chance at Epona, the series' classic horse — register her at a stable once you get her so she doesn't wander off in the wild; also yields the Twilight armor set and the Mirror of Twilight fabric.
卡通林克、少年林克
Toon Link, Young Link
分别出风之勇者套装与赤狮子王布料、时之勇者套装与隆隆牧场布料，都是成套的外观收藏。
These yield the Wind armor set and King of Red Lions fabric, and the Time armor set and Lon Lon Ranch fabric respectively — complete cosmetic collections.
第二档：再刷
Tier 2: Scan Next
魔吉拉面具林克、时之笛林克、天空之剑林克、8-bit 林克
Majora's Mask Link, Ocarina of Time Link, Skyward Sword Link, 8-bit Link
对应鬼神套装与魔吉拉布料、时之勇者套装、大天空之剑与天空勇者套装、初始勇者套装与点阵布料，喜欢旧作外观的玩家优先。

These correspond to the Fierce Deity set and Majora's Mask fabric, the Time armor set, the Great Sky Sword and Sky armor set, and the Hero's set and pixel fabric — players who like classic-game looks should prioritize these.
四英杰（米法、达尔克、力巴尔、乌尔波扎）
The Four Champions (Mipha, Daruk, Revali, Urbosa)
各出对应英杰的神圣头盔与冠军布料，集齐四位等于集齐四套冠军外观。
Each yields their Champion's divine helm and Champion fabric; collecting all four means collecting all four Champion looks.
第三档：随缘
Tier 3: Whenever
波克布林、守护者、加农多夫、王国之泪林克与塞尔达
Bokoblin, Guardian, Ganondorf, Tears of the Kingdom Link and Zelda
波克布林布料、远古布料、魔王布料、英杰服布料与塞尔达公主布料，纯外观收藏，刷到即赚，不必特意追。
Bokoblin fabric, Ancient fabric, Demon King fabric, Champion's Tunic fabric, and Princess Zelda fabric — purely cosmetic collections; getting them is a bonus, no need to chase them deliberately.
一个容易忽略的点：英杰的神圣头盔与各类勇者套装虽然是手办奖励，但它们本身只是防具与外观，不带通关必需的特殊能力。刷的顺序完全可以按自己的喜好排，不存在“错过某只就卡关”的说法。

One easily overlooked point: although the Champions' divine helms and the various Hero sets are figure rewards, they are just armor and looks with no abilities required to beat the game. The scan order can follow your own preferences entirely — there's no such thing as getting stuck because you missed a figure.
布料拿到手还不算完事，它只是换伞面的材料。带上布料去哈特诺村的染坊，找店主选择更换滑翔伞布料，每次收费 20 卢比，换完立刻生效。换伞面只改外观，不改滑翔性能——飞得远不远看的是精力与风力，不是布料花纹，所以选自己看着顺眼的那张就行。

Getting a fabric isn't the end of it — it's just the material for swapping your paraglider. Take the fabric to the dye shop in Hateno Village, ask the shopkeeper to change the paraglider fabric, and it costs 20 Rupees each time, taking effect immediately. Swapping fabric only changes the look, not gliding performance — how far you fly depends on stamina and wind, not the fabric pattern, so just pick the one you like looking at.
收藏上的提醒：布料换上后，想换回原来的样子，同样去染坊再付 20 卢比换回来即可，不必为换回而重新刷手办。换伞面前先确认背包里有这张布料，再去染坊一次办妥。

A collection reminder: once a fabric is on, swapping back to the original look works the same way — go back to the dye shop and pay 20 Rupees again; no need to re-scan figures for the swap-back. Before swapping, confirm the fabric is in your inventory so you can get it done in one trip to the dye shop.
⚠️ 坑一：在悬崖边、水边扫描。
⚠️ Pitfall 1: Scanning near cliffs or water.
奖励从天上掉下来会滚动，悬崖边一滚就掉下去，水边则可能沉进水里捞不回来。扫描前先走到平地，这个步骤不要省。
Rewards roll when they fall from the sky — near a cliff they roll right off, and near water they may sink beyond recovery. Walk to flat ground before scanning; don't skip this step.
⚠️ 坑二：同一只手办一天刷很多遍。
⚠️ Pitfall 2: Scanning the same figure many times in one day.
每天第一次之后再扫同一只不会再掉奖励，纯属浪费时间。正确做法是轮着扫不同的手办，布料收藏靠“只数”而不是“次数”。

After the first scan of the day, scanning the same figure again drops no more rewards — pure wasted time. The right approach is rotating through different figures; fabric collection depends on the number of figures, not the number of scans.
⚠️ 坑三：为限定装备高价买手办。
⚠️ Pitfall 3: Paying a premium for figures for exclusive gear.
多数手办装备在游戏里另有获取途径（例如勇者套装可通过地底的残旧地图宝箱拿到，详见本站
Most figure gear has other ways to obtain it in-game (for example, Hero sets can be found in Depths chests marked by Old Maps — see this site's
），只有滑翔伞布料是手办独占。只为装备买手办之前，先问自己一句：我到底是想要这套衣服，还是想要这张布料？
), and only paraglider fabrics are figure-exclusive. Before buying a figure just for gear, ask yourself: do I want this outfit, or do I want this fabric?
作者视角的判断分两句：第一句，有手办的玩家，每天花两分钟把手头的塞尔达手办轮着扫一遍，是游戏里成本最低的稳定收入——材料、武器、布料全是白给的；第二句，没有手办的玩家完全不必焦虑，王国之泪没有哪件通关必需品锁在手办后面，真正独占的只有滑翔伞布料这类纯外观。手办的正确定位是“收藏加分项”，而不是“付费强度”。按这个定位花钱，才不会买回来后悔。

The author's judgment comes in two parts: first, for players who own figures, spending two minutes a day rotating through your Zelda figures is the cheapest steady income in the game — materials, weapons, and fabrics, all free; second, players without figures need not worry at all — Tears of the Kingdom locks no game-beating essential behind figures, and the only true exclusives are cosmetic items like paraglider fabrics. Figures are properly a "collection bonus," not "paid power." Spending with that framing is how you avoid buyer's remorse.
一句话总结：手办扫的是每天一次的免费奖励，刷之前先定好顺序——先伊波娜与成套勇者装，再冠军布料，最后随缘补外观；拿到布料去哈特诺染坊花 20 卢比换上，就这么简单。

One-line summary: scanning figures is a once-a-day free reward — set your order before you scan: Epona and complete Hero sets first, then Champion fabrics, then casual cosmetic pickups; take fabrics to the Hateno dye shop and pay 20 Rupees to put them on. That's all there is to it.
